description_en: Call the RestartK8sApplication operation to restart an application deployed in a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster or a Serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster
description_zh: 调用RestartK8sApplication接口来重启部署在容器服务K8s集群或Serverless K8s集群中的应用
name: RestartK8sApplication
